description: This bar chart, titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment," illustrates the runtime in seconds for different models, with the horizontal axis listing the model names—“Our Joint Framework,” “ChatGPT,” “DeepSeek,” “LLaMA,” and “Claude”—and the vertical axis labeled “Runtime (seconds)” ranging from 0 to 400 on a linear scale. The chart features a single green bar for “Our Joint Framework” with a value of 77 seconds, and four light blue bars for the LLM models: “ChatGPT” at 190 seconds, “DeepSeek” at 365 seconds, “LLaMA” at 172 seconds, and “Claude” at 243 seconds. The legend indicates that the green bar represents “Our Joint Framework,” while the light blue bars represent “LLM Models.” The bars are arranged in the order of the model names on the x-axis, from left to right, and are not sorted by height. Each bar is labeled with its exact runtime value above it, and the bars are outlined with a black border. There is no visual emphasis or annotation beyond the numerical labels.
